question.text: In the electrical circuit shown in the figure, the current through the $4 \Omega$ resistor is

solution.text: The current through the various branches of the circuit will be shown as According to Kirchhoff's second law in closed circuit $B C D E B$ $$ \begin{array}{r} 2 I_{1}+4 l_{1}+2 l_{1}-8\left(1-l_{1}\right)=0 \\ \Rightarrow \quad 16 l_{1}-81=0 \end{array} $$ $\Rightarrow \quad l_{1}=\frac{8 l}{16} \Rightarrow l_{1}=\frac{1}{2} l$ In closed circuit ABEFA $$ -9+3 l+8\left(1-l_{1}\right)+2 l=0 $$ $\Rightarrow \quad 13l-8 I_{1}=9 \Rightarrow 13 /-8\left(\frac{1}{2} I\right)=9$ $\Rightarrow \quad I=\frac{9}{9}=1 \mathrm{A}$ So current through $4 \Omega$ resistor $l_{1}=\frac{1}{2} \times 1=0.5 \mathrm{A}$
